plans.idea: Classic top-to-bottom story: headline and subhead lead, the bottle sits large in the middle as the visual anchor, then both badges grouped in one row, a full-width CTA, and legal tucked at the foot.
Product-led: the bottle opens the column at the top over the decorative circle (echoing the original's bottle-on-disc), then headline and subhead, badges, CTA and legal follow in one reading stack.
Message-and-offer block up top (headline, subhead, badge row, CTA grouped as one sales unit) with the bottle anchoring the lower half as a big product showcase above the legal line.
